issues.text: New in round 2, in the changed s4 sentence. The guarantee is stated without its condition: the Dart test fails only because product.dart and order.dart cast to non-nullable types (`as int`, `as String`). A field read as `as int?` or with a default (`?? 0`) passes against a sample that lacks it, so the samples can fall behind. The condition appears only later, in s5.
